title: Remote Sensing and Machine Learning-Based Analysis of Land Use and Vegetation Change in Dhaka District, Bangladesh
abstract: arXiv:2608.12001v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rapid urbanization in Dhaka District, Bangladesh has triggered substantial alterations in land use and environmental conditions, necessitating systematic monitoring for informed urban planning and ecological sustainability. This study employs remote sensing data and machine learning techniques to analyze spatiotemporal changes in land cover and vegetation dynamics between 2019 and 2024. High-resolution satellite imagery from Sentinel-2 MSI and Landsat 8 was utilized to classify land cover types and compute spectral indices including the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), Normalized Difference Built-up Index (NDBI), and Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI). A supervised machine learning approach incorporating Decision Tree, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and Random Forest classifiers was applied using labeled geospatial training points within Google Earth Engine. translated_title: 基于遥感和机器学习的孟加拉国达卡区土地利用与植被变化分析
translated_abstract: 孟加拉国达卡区的快速城市化已引发土地利用和环境条件的重大变化，亟需系统监测以支持明智的城市规划和生态可持续性。本研究利用遥感数据和机器学习技术，分析2019年至2024年间土地覆盖和植被动态的时空变化。研究采用Sentinel-2 MSI和Landsat 8的高分辨率卫星影像，对土地覆盖类型进行分类，并计算归一化差异植被指数（NDVI）、归一化差异建成指数（NDBI）和归一化差异水体指数（NDWI）等光谱指数。在Google Earth Engine中，应用包含决策树、K近邻（KNN）和随机森林分类器的监督机器学习方法，使用标记的地理空间训练点进行分类。通过混淆矩阵进行精度评估。
tldr: 本研究利用遥感和机器学习方法，系统分析了2019至2024年达卡区土地利用与植被动态变化，为快速城市化地区的生态监测和规划提供了数据支持。
en_tdlr: This study leverages remote sensing and machine learning to systematically analyze land use and vegetation changes in Dhaka District from 2019 to 2024, providing data support for ecological monitoring and planning in rapidly urbanizing areas.
